title: Email to scheduled work
invariant: Private mailbox access is never granted by a task link.
failure: Duplicate capture offers the existing task; an ambiguous send remains Unknown.

title: Meeting to execution
invariant: Attendee invitations and copied source excerpts require review.
failure: Revoked attendees cannot retrieve newly private notes.

title: Daily planning
invariant: Manual scheduling is L1; assisted Plan My Day is L2.
failure: A stale preview is rejected and unscheduled work keeps an explanation.

title: Research to knowledge
invariant: Linked views reuse one identity and do not grant source access.
failure: Unsafe embeds remain unavailable and removed properties show repair states.

title: Project recovery
invariant: Dependency graphs are acyclic and external meetings are not silently cancelled.
failure: Insufficient capacity leaves work unplaced rather than inventing time.

title: Connection recovery
invariant: Provider recovery cannot destroy app-owned records or resurrect tombstones.
failure: Dropped hints trigger reconciliation; Unknown sends are not blindly replayed.
